title: Step 3 complete: codec-deadline (deadline) 12/12 and codec-i2s-float-convert (i2sfloat/__aeabi_d2ulz) 14/14 verified against stock

deadline.note: 64-bit deadline add + unsigned 64-bit compare in stock (r2:r3 vs r0:r1) matches C deadline<=now path exactly. Both externs already in harness KNOWN; stale meta predated that.

i2sfloat.fn: __aeabi_d2ulz @0x0059823C (stock self-contained leaf, no BL, inline shifts)
i2sfloat.abi_finding: Declared double but carries __attribute__((pcs("aapcs"))) -> double passed in r0:r1 and u64 returned in r0:r1. The harness previously SKIPPED it as 'struct/double' and (hard-float build) could not express the ABI. This is a genuine harness-ABI limitation, not a C-correctness doubt.
i2sfloat.harness_fix: Stream-private, additive, GATED u64-return capture (no effect on other units): (1) hw.h struct call +ret_hi@64; (2) rt.S stores r1->ret_hi after blx; (3) harness.c emits 0xF1 return-hi record; (4) compareg.py compares ret_hi ONLY for fns in meta.u64ret (else masked to a constant, so u32-return units see no r1-scratch false diff); (5) autogen ABI_OVERRIDE treats __aeabi_d2ulz as two core uint32 words, seeds double bit-patterns across all branches, flags u64ret, resolves stock 0x59823C. __aeabi_llsl/__aeabi_llsr resolved by libgcc at link.
i2sfloat.regression: deadline re-run under the new harness = 12/12 unchanged (gating verified).
i2sfloat.coverage: 14 seeded (hi,lo)-word doubles exercise: sign!=0 ->0; encoded<1023 ->0; encoded>=1087 ->UINT64_MAX; shift>=52 (significand<<) and shift<52 (significand>>); zero; inf/nan; negative. Full 64-bit result (r0+r1) compared bit-exact; readable C == stock optimized bit-twiddle on every pattern.

c_changes: NONE (driver C already correct; only stream-private harness extended). Therefore no paired-sim rerun required per the standing rule.
